body:
## Pull request overview Ports Select’s autofill + selected-state fixes to Combobox, aiming to keep selection/Field state consistent across browser autofill, canceled change events, and multiple-selection “dirty” tracking, while also correcting `aria-controls` targeting when the input lives inside the popup. **Changes:** - Update autofill handling to match against rendered labels (when needed) and route Field dirty/validation updates through `useValueChanged`, respecting canceled `onValueChange` / `onInputValueChange`. - Make `aria-controls` point to the dialog popup (stable `${rootId}-popup` default), with a shared `getComboboxPopupId` helper and support for custom popup ids. - Improve multiple-mode dirty detection by comparing arrays element-by-element using the item comparator; add regression tests for these edge cases. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | packages/react/src/combobox/trigger/ComboboxTrigger.tsx | Switch `aria-controls` to target the popup when the input is inside it; use stored popup id with a default fallback. | | packages/react/src/combobox/trigger/ComboboxTrigger.test.tsx | Update ARIA expectations and add a regression test for typeahead after open/close with `items`. | | packages/react/src/combobox/store.ts | Add `popupId` to store state/selectors for trigger ↔ popup coordination. | | packages/react/src/combobox/root/utils/index.ts | Introduce `getComboboxPopupId(rootId)` to centralize the popup id convention. | | packages/react/src/combobox/root/ComboboxRoot.test.tsx | Add extensive regression coverage for autofill matching, canceled changes, and multiple-mode dirty comparisons. | | packages/react/src/combobox/root/AriaCombobox.tsx | Route dirty/validation updates through `useValueChanged`, add comparator-based dirty checks for arrays, and refine autofill matching/mounting logic. | | packages/react/src/combobox/popup/ComboboxPopup.tsx | Apply/derive popup id and publish it into the store (layout effect) for `aria-controls`. | | packages/react/src/combobox/list/ComboboxList.tsx | Adjust `CompositeList` label registration so derived labels survive unmounts unless force-mounting for rendered-label autofill matching. | | packages/react/src/combobox/label/ComboboxLabel.tsx | Change `ComboboxLabelState` to an interface for correct docs/type resolution. | | docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/combobox/types.md | Fix generated docs so `Combobox.Label` state types resolve correctly. |
